purpose: diagnose whether one shared pinhole focal/depth-scale correction explains raw pair discrepancies before operational pose fitting

model.fixed: principal point, focal aspect ratio, distortion, depth offset, original depth/GT clocks and qualification scorer; no second manufacturer depth correction
model.geometry: p = exp(b)*diag(exp(-a),exp(-a),1)*p_base; target normal follows inverse transpose with normalization; its derivative is included

data.role: all three are previously viewed FR1 recordings; validation endpoints differ from training endpoints, but no fresh heldout/generalization claim
data.correspondences: original fine stride2 forward/normal/distance admission at original K and offline interpolated reference relative pose; keep every eighth admitted pair in row-major order; freeze pair identities and target base normals

solver.loss: Huber .01 m; each pair equal weight and both training records equal weight

trial_eligibility.validation_all_three: nonincreasing fixed-support robust cost, raw RMS, median position correction and median rotation correction at reference pose

limitations: two-parameter model omits image registration warp, timing, principal point, normal uncertainty, association and reference errors; per-pixel residuals are correlated; fits are development diagnostics
